flows.name: Redridge multi-quest stop story tooltip
steps: Open the Redridge world map and hover stop 1 of 10
Inspect chapter and successor text for The Everstill Bridge and A Baying of Gnolls; Then describes successors without an instruction or fabricated unlock level

flows.name: Chosen journey card and guide tab
steps: Open the native quest sidebar and select Adventure Guide
Inspect Redridge Mountains story card, compass tab, route rows and footer with no overlapping controls or misleading progress ring

flows.name: Outgrown journey setting and grey quests
steps: Enable Show outgrown zones and dungeons
Return to journey choices, expand quest destinations, select Dun Morogh at character level 20
Inspect grey Dwarven Outfitters level 1, A New Threat level 2, The Boar Hunter level 3 steps without accepting or completing quests
